refresh_conclusion: S38 remains the newest promoted source and stays historical direct-complementary only, with zero H1-H5 numeric effect. Fresh official/institutional follow-up found no defensible S39. The Covasna 2026 report is retained only as a pending-content candidate; current training, vacancy, funding and project pages are not used as evidence of need.
next_refresh_rule: Promote a new source only when its actual content can be read and it provides materially stronger target-population evidence with enough provenance and method detail to classify its limits. A listing, project objective, funding offer or training activity is insufficient.
